programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: O'S**t reaches new "baby mama" heights when he reveals that he has yet another child on the way. Dutchess shows up at a meeting and sees an ex-boyfriend. When Ceaser finds out, he loses his cool and deserts her at his family BBQ. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: In the wake of Dutchess and Ceaser's fight, Ceaser is left confused about their future together and escapes to Puma's bachelor party in Atlantic City. Kathy comes for a tattoo from O'S**t, to get some closure and move on with her life. Presented by VH1.
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew Have Several Seats

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Puma decides to invite Ceaser to his wedding on the condition that he leaves Dutchess at home. Walt's frustrating search comes to an end when a letter arrives at the shop with information about his father. Presented by VH1.
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew You Got Some Stupid Ears

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: O'S**t's baby mamas, Coley and Kathy, face each other for the first time since their violent "family meal." Ceaser is torn between his friends and his woman as Dutchess reacts negatively to not being invited to Puma's wedding. Presented by VH1.
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew Tell the Truth and Shame the Devil

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: When O'S**t reappears at the shop, Walt tears into him about friendship and responsibility. After fighting in Jamaica together, Dutchess runs from the resort and, unbeknownst to Ceaser, ends up collapsing in the parking lot. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: The crew are having the time of their lives in Jamaica but are shocked when Ceaser suddenly sends Dutchess packing! At the wedding, the crew is left wondering if this Black Ink love story will have an unhappy ending. Presented by VH1.
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew From Wedlock to Headlock

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Don starts his career as a piercer at 9Mag. Charmaine's mom gives her devastating news. Phor attempts to reconnect with family. Cobra gets turned on by her new roommate. Nikki goes ballistic when Phor's alleged cousin, Janelle, shows up. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Don freaks out after Ashley gives him news. Lily and Cobra come to blows. Van struggles to deal with the fallout from his breakup. When Ryan throws a party for Bone Thugs-n-Harmony, Charmaine seizes an opportunity to get her job back. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Lily jeopardizes her relationship with JR. Cobra confronts Ryan about a rumor. Van has a questionable plan to win Jenn back. Danielle throws a fashion show to help promote her new fashion blog. Ryan is rushed to the emergency room. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Ryan returns to the shop after a major health scare. JR learns disturbing information about his relationship with Lily. Phor questions his career as a tattoo artist. And Lily takes down Cobra after she meddles in her relationship. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Lily tries to turn the shop against Cobra. Charmaine's relationship is on rocky ground when her career takes priority over Neek. Nikki's jealousy rears its ugly head again. Don blows up after hearing the crew bully Cobra. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Ryan is devastated when an injury prevents him from tatting his childhood idols. Charmaine tries to persuade Cobra to stay at 9Mag. Jenn's nip slip sends Van over the edge. A photo shoot for a major tattoo magazine nearly gets derailed. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: The crew is back in Harlem, making money and wilin' out. All is back to normal, except for one thing…no Dutchess. Meanwhile, on the other side of Harlem, Puma throws a grand opening party for his new shop, Ink 124. Presented by VH1.
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew Cease and Desist

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: O'S**t goes to court, where he learns some unsettling information about his case. Dutchess and Puma attempt to make amends. While Dutch tattoos DJ Whoo Kidd at the shop, Ceaser makes a decision that is bound to change everything. Presented by VH1.
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew We All Got Problems

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Ceaser got caught cheating on Dutchess and he needs his brother Ty's help getting his things from her apartment. Dutch confides in Sky, putting Sky's loyalty to Ceaser to the test. O S**t asks Puma to accompany him ring shopping. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Ceaser faces Dutchess for the first time since she kicked him out of the apartment. Dutchess decides to see a plastic surgeon about breast implants. O'S**t decides it's time to get all three of his baby mamas together for a dinner. Presented by VH1.
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew Baby Mama Role Call

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: O'S**t's past has come back to haunt him when a mystery woman turns up at the shop. While Dutch reconnects with everyone but Ceaser. During the party, Cease and Puma have an idea that has the potential to change Black Ink's future. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: A solo hiker in the Carpathian Mountains breaks his hip and femur when he is crushed by multiple avalanches.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: Linda Forney and her pet dog Cocoa Gin set off to explore one of the seven natural wonders of the Grand Canyon.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Deadly Sore Throat
programme.desc: A wheezing woman comes to the ER with a difficult-to-diagnose breathing problem, and a very angry husband! A grown man suddenly begins acting bizarrely like a child; is his medication helping him, or making him worse?!?

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: The Big Save
programme.desc: An anesthesiologist has a heart attack; a pregnant woman has a cerebral aneurysm; doctors are sprayed with blood from a man who was stabbed in the heart; a prostitute's unusual hiding place for money is found.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Turtle Trouble
programme.desc: An alligator snapping turtle is clamped to a man's neck and won't let go; an ER physician races against an impending hurricane to clear the ER of patients before it hits; a tree trimmer is 20 feet above ground when he is impaled by his chainsaw.

programme.title: Couples Therapy
programme.desc: Marjorie & Jason clash; a breach upends Sienna & Chris. Season premiere.

programme.title: Couples Therapy
programme.desc: Chris admits infidelities; Clinton's meltdown leads Orna to seek advice.

programme.title: Killer Mysteries
programme.desc: A businessman by day transforms into a sadomasochistic by night. This veteran conman lures unsuspecting women with a web of lies and empty promises.

programme.title: I Lived with a Killer
programme.desc: Michael Bear Carson and his wife, Suzan, leave a trail of death when they set out to kill witches.

programme.title: I Lived with a Killer
programme.desc: William Choyce's ex-wife and daughter are grateful to be alive after living with a serial killer.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: A train passenger behaves oddly en route to Arizona and then disappears. The next day his bloodied body is found in Texas. Dr. G attempts to piece together this bizarre tragedy.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: Motor vehicle fatalities account for many of the cases that come into the morgue. Dr. G offers expertise as to how to get behind the wheel and not wind up on a steel table.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: A retired military officer is found dead in his own backyard during a freak ice storm in San Antonio, Texas.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: Charlie Hench has set himself a big challenge before he turns the big 50.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: In August 2002, a young man and woman, once dating, headed for the Amazon rain forest but got lost in the jungle. They have to survive the dangers of the jungle and hold on to their sanity as they find their way home.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: A father and son on a hunting expedition in Kyrgyzstan are caught in a blizzard.

programme.title: Sex, Lies & Murder
programme.desc: A couple hires a baby sitter but they end up getting much more than they bargained for.

programme.title: Sex, Lies & Murder
programme.desc: Adam and Rose Chase seem to be living a perfect life, until Adam goes missing.

programme.title: Brusco despertar
programme.desc: Bruce Willis, Sigourney Weaver y Henry Cavill protagonizan este thriller trepidante sobre un hombre que intenta salvar a su familia secuestrada.

programme.title: Asesino a Sueldo
programme.desc: Slevin (Josh Hartnett) se marcha de Los Ángeles, por un error de identidad cae en medio de una guerra entre los dos jefes criminales más temidos de la ciudad: El rabino (Ben Kingsley) y el jefe (Morgan Freeman).

programme.title: Bent: Plan de venganza
programme.desc: En este mordaz thriller policíaco, un policía desacreditado que busca al asesino de su compañero descubre accidentalmente una conspiración gubernamental vinculada al asesinato de una mujer con un coche bomba.

programme.title: La hora de tu muerte
programme.desc: Las superestrellas de la WWE Dolph Ziggler y Kane protagonizan esta emocionante película de suspenso y acción sobre un policía que compite contra el tiempo para detener a un terrorista loco y salvar a un niño.

programme.title: Zona de combate
programme.desc: Tres hombres, tres mundos y tres guerras diferentes; todos en la intersección de una guerra moderna. Un mundo turbio inestable de moralidad donde todo no es como se ve.

programme.title: Asesina en fuga
programme.desc: Maya es objeto de la mafia rusa tras la muerte de su esposo. Al negarse a cooperar, es incriminada y enviada a prisión.

programme.title: Hombres de élite
programme.desc: En este tenso thriller protagonizado por John Travolta y Kate Bosworth, un equipo de trabajadores de líneas eléctricas de Texas se apresura a instalar kilómetros de cable antes de que una mortal tormenta eléctrica destruya la red eléctrica.

programme.title: El Castigador: zona de guerra
programme.desc: Frank Castle, alias Punisher, regresa con su estilo de justiciero solitario. Cuando Frank hiere al despiadado mafioso Billy Russoti, este jura vengarse y recluta un ejército de hombres tan peligrosos como él.

programme.title: San Valentín sangriento
programme.desc: Una nueva versión de la clásica película de terror de 1981 de George Mihalka, San Valentín sangriento tiene lugar diez años después de un devastador accidente en una mina de carbón con una serie de horribles asesinatos que atormentan a una pequeña ciudad.

programme.title: Yo, Frankenstein
programme.desc: Adam, un monstruo creado por Frankenstein, se da cuenta de que su verdadera misión es salvar a la humanidad después de encontrarse en medio de una guerra entre dos clanes inmortales de demonios y gárgolas.

programme.title: Solomon Kane (ESP)
programme.desc: El capitán Solomon Kane (James Purefoy) es una máquina de matar brutalmente eficiente del siglo XVI.

programme.title: Asesinos del más allá
programme.desc: Un profesor de secundaria (Tim Matheson) se enfrenta a los fantasmas demoníacos de una pandilla de exalumnos. Con actuaciones de Brooke Adams, Robert Hy Gorman, Robert Rusler, Nicholas Sadler y William Sanderson. Basada en un relato de Stephen King.

programme.title: Escondete
programme.desc: Dos parejas jóvenes han elegido un nuevo sitio para su borrachera: un cuartel abandonado donde hace 45 años, una niña, con discapacidad mental, fue seducida y violada, estrangulada y luego quemada.

programme.title: Para Elisa
programme.desc: Tras responder a un anuncio para un trabajo de niñera, Ana descubre que la persona a su cargo, Elisa, es una joven violentamente trastornada de su misma edad. Ana, atrapada en la casa como el nuevo juguete de Elisa, debe luchar para sobrevivir.

programme.title: Del crepúsculo al amanecer
programme.desc: En este clásico de Tarantino, los bandidos hermanos Gecko ¡cometen una ola de crímenes! Secuestran a un padre y sus dos hijos, y se esconden en un bar mexicano. Pero se enfrentarán a los clientes del bar y se unirán a sus rehenes para sobrevivir.

programme.title: South Park: Hotter than Summer: Cartman's Mom is a Dirty S**t (Part 1)
programme.desc: Cartman's Mum Is A Dirty S**t (1): Dr. Mephisto helps Cartman un-cover the truth about his dad's identity. The spotlight is on quite a few of South Park's male residents. Who could it be? (S1, E13)
programme.sub-title: Hotter than Summer: Cartman's Mom is a Dirty S**t (Part 1)

programme.title: South Park: Hotter than Summer: Cartman's Mom Is Still A Dirty S**t (Part 2)
programme.desc: Cartman's Mum Is Still A Dirty S**t (2): Dr Mephisto is shot before he reveals who Cartman's father is. Who exactly shot him? Meanwhile, the rest of the town try to deal with a blizzard. (S2, E02)
programme.sub-title: Hotter than Summer: Cartman's Mom Is Still A Dirty S**t (Part 2)

programme.title: South Park: Hotter Than Summer: Chickenlover
programme.desc: Chicken-Lover: When Barbrady calls the boys in to help solve the case of the notorious, perverted Chicken-Lover, Cartman gets a little carried away with his new-found 'authoritah'. (S2, E03)

programme.title: South Park: Ike's Wee Wee
programme.desc: Ike's Wee Wee: Kyle misunderstands what circumcision is and thinks he has to save Ike's penis from being cut off! Mr. Mackey is fired, and turns to drugs - "drugs are bad, m'kay?" (S2, E04)

programme.title: South Park: Conjoined Fetus Lady
programme.desc: Conjoined Fetus Lady: Kyle is terrified because he has to see the school nurse, who has a scary deformity. Meanwhile, the school dodgeball team goes to China - only Pip can save them now. (S2, E05)

programme.title: South Park: The Mexican Staring Frog of Southern Sri Lanka
programme.desc: The Mexican Staring Frog Of Southern Sri Lanka: After being duped by Stan's Uncle Jimbo, the boys decide to take revenge by making bogus videos of a certain frog. Will Jesus stand for this? (S2, E06)
programme.sub-title: The Mexican Staring Frog of Southern Sri Lanka

programme.title: South Park: City on the Edge of Forever
programme.desc: City On The Edge Of Forever: The school bus ends up perched on the edge of a ravine after it crashes in a snowstorm. Must be time for some flashbacks then! Can these memories be trusted? (S2, E07)
programme.sub-title: City on the Edge of Forever

programme.title: South Park: Summer Sucks
programme.desc: Summer Sucks: The boys' plans for 4th of July celebrations are ruined when the State bans fireworks. It's up to Uncle Jimbo and Ned to save the day with a little trip down Meheeco way. (S2, E08)

programme.title: The Border

programme.title: The Border
programme.desc: An American pop star collapses in New York city and her death is linked to a Canadian cancer medication, prescribed in Toronto and shipped across the border. Kessler and LaGarda investigate the Canadian pharmaceutical company responsible.

programme.title: Mega Shark vs Giant Octopus
programme.desc: Incidentes inexplicables están ocurriendo en todo el Océano Pacífico cuando un grupo de científicos rebeldes descubrió un tiburón megalodón prehistórico y se ha desatado un pulpo gigante gracias a una operación militar ilegal.

programme.title: Mega Shark vs Mecha Shark
programme.desc: Cuando un nuevo Mega Shark amenaza a la humanidad, el gobierno desata al Mecha Shark para derrotar al monstruo en una batalla campal que amenaza al planeta entero.

programme.title: Cuenta Regresiva
programme.desc: Un profesor universitario se encuentra con una serie de números encontrados en una cápsula de tiempo, y llega a darse cuenta de que han predicho cada desastre de los últimos 50 años.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una pareja se ve atacada por fuerzas espirituales convocadas por un ex celoso. A medida que las fuerzas se vuelven más violentas, recurren a múltiples expertos en su intento de romper la maldición por cualquier medio antes de que los disuelva.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Mary Jo Chudley queda encantada con un par de muñecas coleccionables y las lleva a casa. Los llama "Gretchen" y "Lily Mae" y pronto sufre una enfermedad relacionada con la sangre que casi la mata. ¿Son las muñecas responsables?

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una pareja remodela una antigua granja, despertando un espíritu que se burla de ellos y de su pequeña hija, en un intento de resolver deudas centenarias. Después de un encuentro casi fatal, una médium y dos investigadores se unen para poner fin al acoso.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando una joven pareja comienza a experimentar eventos inexplicables, descubren que el residente anterior nunca se fue. Los investigadores paranormales se dan cuenta de que el edificio necesita una liberación antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: El sueño de Kim y Eric Masson de tener un restaurante se ve interrumpido cuando se dan cuenta de que el edificio está embrujado. Cuando la inquietud se vuelve terrible, los Masson acuden a la ayuda de investigadores paranormales.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Los espiritistas algunas veces hablan sobre cierta región de la existencia donde los espíritus vagan libres de cuerpos materiales, y ellos la llaman “la otra vida”.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: En este mundo, la verdadera maldad existe. Acecha dentro de las sombras más oscuras, así como en los lugares más sencillos. Se disfraza con muchas máscaras para engañarnos y, finalmente, destruirnos.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: La ciencia moderna nos afirma que, en el nivel más simple, el mundo material no es más que energía y que todos estamos conectados de forma física con el mundo que nos rodea.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Ron y Nancy están convencidos de que su nuevo hogar es demasiado bueno para ser verdad: la histórica casa Baltimore se adapta de forma ideal a su presupuesto y además es tan grande como para alojar a su gran familia.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Existen algunos lazos que no pueden romperse, tal como el vínculo que se establece entre una madre y su hija... o el vínculo psíquico entre un asesino y su víctima.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando Clara y su familia se mudan a una pequeña casa en la zona rural de Hinsdale, Nueva York, se dan cuenta de que la paz de la vida en el campo es simplemente una ilusión y la amenaza de muerte es muy real.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: La casa de rancho de Ed y Beth parece el lugar perfecto para criar a su niño pequeño, hasta que descubren que no están solos y una espesa niebla oscura se cierne sobre la casa y crece día a día.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: En la vida, las personas pueden vivir atormentadas por sus propios crímenes. Lo mismo también puede ocurrir en la muerte: espíritus enojados pueden quedar estacionados en el mismo lugar donde perdieron su humanidad.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: ¿Qué tan diferente podría ser nuestra realidad si no pudiéramos sentir y comunicarnos de las formas más convencionales? Para Marie, este es un tema que forma parte de su día a día. Su hija Julie padece una condición mental que la debilita.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Algunas personas creen que los fantasmas son espíritus humanos que deben lidiar con asuntos aún pendientes y que quizás puedan necesitar la ayuda de los vivos, con el fin de encontrar la paz entre los muertos.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Deb y Tony acaban de comenzar su vida juntos. Con su primer hijo en camino, la pareja trabajadora se muda a una pintoresca casa en Atchison, en el estado de Kansas, con muchas esperanzas en el futuro.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: En la isla de Taiwán muchas personas creen que no existen fronteras entre el mundo material y el reino espiritual. Los fantasmas forman parte de la vida cotidiana.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Hay un demonio suelto en una casa de Connecticut, y un niño de 12 años se lleva la peor parte de su ira. Él ve a un anciano con pezuñas y cuernos, lo golpean y lo arrojan y finalmente es poseído. Solo un exorcismo salvará su alma.

programme.title: El Enamorado
programme.desc: Martin Corona encuentra el amor y promote a su esposa a no volver a usar armas, hasta que sus enemigos lo obligan a volver a luchar, ahora por defender a su propia familia.

programme.title: La Vida de Pedro Infante
programme.desc: Una historia emotiva y tierna basada en la vida real de Pedro Infante, el cantante y actor más famoso de México. Sus comienzos, sus triunfos, su pasión por los aviones, sus amores y su trágica muerte en plena flor de su edad.

programme.title: Cuando Habla El Corazon
programme.desc: Historia que demuestra la amistad entre dos amigos, que a lo largo de los años se demuestran que hay que ser valientes y leales. Tratando de defender a su amada, pero también a la fiel a la amistad que se deben.

programme.title: Juana Gallo
programme.desc: La verdadera historia de Angela Ramos, una joven campesina que llegó a ser la cabeza de una guerrilla que luchó exitosamente contra las fuerzas federales del usurpador Victoriano Huerta. El pueblo la llamó por su fiereza “Juana Gallo”.

programme.title: Arriba Las Manos Texano
programme.desc: El texano, hijo de Manuel Saldivar, un asesino cruel y desalmado, emprende un viaje para llegar al rancho de Joe Pastrana. Al llegar se entera por su hija, que Joe a muerto victima de una balacera comandada por Jim, un cruel hombre.

programme.title: El Texano
programme.desc: Manuel Saldívar, conocido como el texano viaja a un pueblo minero para cobrar venganza por la muerte de su hermano juan Saldívar quien fue acusado injustamente de cobrar un poco de oro.

programme.title: Vuelve El Texano
programme.desc: El texano, es un hombre muy famoso del pueblo de Santa Fe, el decide regresar a su pueblo natal, a su llegada se entera de que alguien ha estado matando a varias personas e incluso a extorsionarlas por lo que decide descubrir y eliminar al susodicho.

programme.title: Una horca para el texano
programme.desc: Frank, Peter, Robert y Leop Morgan son buscados por todo un pueblo,ya que roban bancos y matan. Pronto un comisario llega para resolver el asesinato del presidente del banco y poner tras las rejas a estos cuatro bandidos.

programme.title: Tin Tan y Las Modelos
programme.desc: Tin-Tan y su esposa Severa son los directores del Patronato de la Moral y Etica Social. Sin embargo Tin-Tan tuvo como antepasado a Casanova, quien le da tres maravillosas lecciones de amor con tres hermosas jovenes, Rosa, Teresa y Mapita.

programme.title: Tres lecciones de amor
programme.desc: Tin-Tan es un vendedor de productos de belleza que conoce aun grupo de hermosas jóvenes que aspiran a ser modelos. Decide ayudarlas y organiza una exhibición de modas que las hace triunfar en la Televisión.

programme.title: Viaje A La Luna
programme.desc: Como parte de un truco publicitario de la marca de cigarros arabe bujala, el caballerro del crisantemo es raptado por su publicista y sus lunaticos con el objetivo de que no de a conocer su identidad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan se horroriza al darse cuenta de que ha malinterpretado a uno de los mejores escritores de todos los tiempos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman no está contento cuando su madre consigue un nuevo trabajo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Mucho depende de la habilidad de Butters para aplastar a la competencia en un importante campeonato de doma.
programme.sub-title: De vuelta a la Guerra Fría

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos descubren que la alegría de jugar Airsoft viene con el desafío de tratar con adolescentes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Butters se sorprende al saber que la gente de South Park no entiende de qué se trata realmente el Día de San Patricio.
programme.sub-title: Hierba Crédigre Especial del día de San Patricio

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman le cuenta a sus amigos sobre un extraño sueño que tuvo en donde unos ''visitantes'' lo abducen y le ponen una sonda anal. Pero al parecer, no fue sólo un sueño, ya que algo está desollando a las vacas del pequeño pueblo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman gana el concurso de ensayos "Salva a nuestro frágil planeta" y se anuncia que Kathie Lee Gifford le dará el premio. Esto enoja a Wendy, porque cree que Cartman hizo trampa y al Señor Garrison porque odia a Gifford.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos se van de caza con Jimbo, el tío de Stan, y su viejo amigo Ned. Mientras tanto, un volcán está a punto de hacer erupción y la alcaldesa McDaniels aprovecha la oportunidad para promocionar al pueblo de South Park en televisión.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan tiene un nuevo perro llamado Sparky que resulta ser gay, por lo que todos sus compañeros se burlan de él. Cuando Sparky se va de casa, Stan lo busca en el Santuario de Animales del Gran Gay Al y aprende algo sobre la homosexualidad.
programme.sub-title: El gran crucero del Gran Gay Al

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos intentan cruzar al elefante de Kyle con ''Fofa'', la cerda de Cartman, para un experimento genético de la escuela con el cual intentan ganarle a Terrance. Mientras, Stan lucha contra los abusos físicos de su hermana, Shelly.
programme.sub-title: Un elefante hace el amor con una cerda

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El abuelo de Stan cumple 102 años y quiere suicidarse, pero al no poder hacerlo, le pide a Stan que lo ayude.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kenny es aplastado por la Estación Espacial Mir y se convierte en un zombi que desata la epidemia por todo el pueblo. Pero el doctor diagnostíca a todos como si tuvieran conjuntivitis.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuando Damián, el hijo de Satanás, llega a South Park, él y su padre anuncian que la batalla final con Jesús se realizará en una lucha de boxeo que decidirá quién es el más fuerte.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Después de ver un comercial sobre la hambruna en África, los chicos deciden patrocinar a un niño y envían dinero a la organización de Sally Struthers con la esperanza de obtener un reloj digital deportivo a cambio.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La señora Broflovski protesta por las actividades navideñas que se realizan en la escuela. Mientras tanto, Kyle se siente solo por ser judío y nadie le cree cuando trata de convencer al pueblo sobre la existencia del Señor Mojón.
programme.sub-title: El Señor Mojón, la mierda navideña

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El señor Garrison se hace una cirugía plástica en la nariz y abandona la enseñanza para convertirse en un modelo. Mientras tanto, Stan se enamora de Ellen, la maestra sustituta, de modo que Wendy, su novia, se pone celosa.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos encuentran un antiguo objeto triangular en una excavación escolar. Luego de salir en el noticiero, Barbra Streisand aparece buscándolo ya que es lo que necesita para poder convertirse en un monstruo gigante japonés.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman siente curiosidad de saber quién es su padre, pero averiguarlo no es una tarea fácil debido a que su madre se acostó con muchos hombres.
programme.sub-title: La mamá de Cartman es una puta sucia

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Terrance y Phillip tienen que rescatar a la hija bastarda que Terrance tuvo con Celine Dion de las manos de Saddam Hussein y su archi-enemigo, Scott.
programme.sub-title: Terrance y Phillip en "No sin mi Anus"

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Continuación de ''La mamá de Cartman es una puta sucia'', en el que Cartman quiere averiguar quién es su padre. Con la ayuda de Chef, los chicos tienen que salvar al Doctor Mephesto luego de recibir un disparo.
programme.sub-title: La madre de Cartman es aún una sucia perra

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un violador de gallinas anda suelto en South Park y el Oficial Barbrady no puede atraparlo porque es analfabeto y no puede leer las pistas que deja el criminal.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Sr. Mackey es despedido de la escuela por perder una hoja de marihuana durante una presentación en contra de las drogas. Entretanto, los chicos tratan de salvar a Ike de su fiesta ''bris'' en donde le harán la circuncisión.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Aunque todos odian jugar a los quemados, los chicos están obligados a participar en el campeonato. Mientras tanto, Sheila lucha para que se conozca el caso de ''mixlésia de hermanos siameses'' de la enfermera escolar.
programme.sub-title: La dama de los fetos unidos

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos tienen que escribir sobre la guerra de Vietnam así que visitan a Jimbo y Ned en el set de su programa de Caza y Matanza, el cual está compitiendo por el rating con Jesús y Sus Amigos.
programme.sub-title: El sapo Mejicano mirón del sur de Sri Lanka

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El autobús escolar va por una carretera nevada hasta que, por accidente, termina atascado al borde de un barranco. La señora Crabtree sale a buscar ayuda, pero primero les dice a los chicos que si bajan, un monstruo se los comerá.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una prohibición de fuegos artificiales amenaza las festividades del 4 de Julio hasta que el alcalde idea un plan poner a South Park nuevamente en el mapa.

programme.title: South Park

programme.sub-title: Las bolas de chocolate saladas del Chef

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos son obligados por sus madres a dormir en la casa de Kenny para que se contagien la varicela. Al mismo tiempo, Sheila intenta arreglar la amistad perdida entre su marido y el padre de Kenny.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos van de excursión al planetario y un empleado les lava el cerebro con efectos visuales para que quieran volver allí. Mientras, Cartman sólo se preocupa por ganar un casting para salir en el nuevo comercial de “Quesitos Poofs”.
programme.sub-title: Roger Ebert debería dejar las comidas engordantes

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Todo South Park festeja el "Día de las Vacas", que incluye una feria, un monumento y la corrida de las vacas. Mientras tanto, los chicos hacen lo que sea para ganar unos muñecos de Terrance y Philip.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Chef reclama los derechos de la nueva canción de Alanis Morissette, ''Calzón Sucio'', pero de alguna forma termina siendo demandado. Ahora los chicos, Elton John y otros músicos tratan de juntar el dinero para ayudar a Chef.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La ''Tía Regla'' de Stan le regala un pez dorado que le da mucho miedo y comienzan a haber asesinatos que la mamá de Stan trata de encubrir. Mientras tanto, Cartman se comporta muy extraño de repente y tiene barba.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan se fuga de su casa para ir a Nebraska con los demás, a visitar a los parientes de Cartman en Navidad. Allí, los niños quieren ir a ver al Señor Mojón. Mientras, el tío de Cartman y Charles Manson se escapan de la cárcel.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos son obligados a escribir una redacción sobre pequeñas empresas junto a Tweek, un niño raro y nervioso, el cual sugiere que la redacción se haga sobre los "Gnomos roba calzones".

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos descubren a un hombre congelado desde hace tres años, y ahora Stan y Kyle se pelean para ver quién lo descubrió y qué nombre ponerle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Varios habitantes de South Park explotan sin razón aparente y Randy es el encargado de descubrir por qué. Por otro lado, los chicos tienen que representar las "Estaciones de la cruz" en misa, y Kyle trata de ''conseguir una erección''.

programme.title: Una aventura salvaje
programme.desc: Dos hermanos y un perro se unen para sobrevivir en la selva después de un accidente.

programme.title: El hechicero del diablo

programme.title: Locas Por El Dinero

programme.title: Hasta la muerte

programme.title: En tierra extraña
programme.desc: La desaparición de los hijos de una familia en el desierto desata rumores sobre su pasado.

programme.title: Persecución en la nieve

programme.title: Retroceder nunca, rendirse jamás

programme.title: La leyenda del gigante de la montaña
programme.desc: En esta aventura de la mitología nórdica, Espen "Ash Lad" embarca en una peligrosa aventura.

programme.title: Balas voladoras
programme.desc: Un detective investiga muertes misteriosas en una fábrica de balas.

programme.title: El último destino
programme.desc: Dentro de las calles solitarias vive Matt, un joven que está en busca de su madre. Ray, un detective, le daría información sobre aquella mujer si él se revela como testigo en un caso.

programme.title: Sam Chruchill Buscando un Vagabundo
programme.desc: No es la primera vez que Sam Churchill amanece acompañado de una hermosa mujer, pero es la primera vez que se ha encontrado atado a una. Lentamente recupera la conciencia y recuerda que él y su clienta Laura Enders, fueron secuestrados la noche anterior.

programme.title: Seduccion y Robo
programme.desc: Despues de ser robado un lujoso collar de un Hotel, Jake el jefe de seguridad del lugar es sospechoso de complicidad y es despedido de su trabajo. Jake decidido a comprobar su inocencia sigue las huellas dejadas en un gafete y halla a Claire la ladrona.

programme.title: Alguien al Acecho
programme.desc: Michelle y su hijo de 6 años Cory, se mudan a una nueva casa, a partir de esa fecha Cory comienza a portarse agresivo y hace mención a su nuevo amigo BJ. Su madre preocupada asiste con una psicóloga quien le dice que BJ debe ser un espíritu inofensivo.

programme.title: Striking Poses
programme.desc: Gage es una jóven y atractiva paparazzi que trabaja en una revista de escándalos, su sueño siempre ha sido ser una gran periodista, pero ahora es ella quien está en la mira de los demás y por lo tanto se encuentra en riesgo su vida.

programme.title: The Art of Murder
programme.desc: Elizabeth es chantajeada por Willie, un fotógrafo que ha captado imágenes con momentos íntimos de ella con su amante. Cuando ella realiza el pago para no ser mostradas las fotografías a su esposo, el fotógrafo trata de aprovecharse de ella.

programme.title: The Girl next door
programme.desc: Historia es basada en hechos reales, narra la historia de una joven mujer que es manipulada por el hombre que ama para matar a la esposa de éste. Ella ingenua como siempre e inspirada por el amor acepta a cometer el crimen y conservar al hombre que ama

programme.title: Mentiras Santas
programme.desc: Una mujer huye del padre de su hija, albergandose en un hogar para madres solteras comienza una nueva vida donde encuentra el amor y nuevas amistades. Quince años más tarde, las circunstancias llevan a su marido abandonado a este albergue

programme.title: Servidor del Crimen
programme.desc: El teniente Ray Harlan, ha pasado los últimos quince años en las duras y frías calles de Nueva York, sin amigos y sin una vida social fuera de su trabajo como policía. Ray esta en busca de su salvación en su antiguo hogar.

programme.title: El Inquilino Perfecto
programme.desc: Un día de invierno, David encuentra a su padre muerto en su casa. Jessica su esposa acusa al padre de David de violador y suicida. David no está conforme con ello y es recluido a un instituto psiquiátrico.

programme.title: South Park

programme.desc: Stan y Kyle se obsesionan tanto con Guitar Hero que llegan al punto de romper récords, lo que hace que Stan considere llegar más lejos consiguiendo un compañero diferente.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Mientras la señora Garrison está tratando de encontrar una forma de convertirse en el hombre que siempre intentó ser, Cartman es puesto a cargo del salón de clases.

programme.desc: Cartman ha sido diagnosticado con ansiedad.

programme.title: South Park

programme.desc: El sueño de Cartman de ser un pirata se convierte en realidad.

programme.desc: Una nueva alumna llega a la escuela primaria de South Park y es negra por lo que Cartman cree que debería hacer pareja con Token, y no dejará que nadie se interponga en el camino, en especial Kyle.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle se enoja con sus padres por no dejarlo ir al concierto de los Raging Pussies, y Cartman le recomienda que le diga a la policía que sus padres lo masturbaron para que los arresten.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se considera el crítico número uno en Internet de restaurantes en South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos intentan cruzar al elefante de Kyle con ''Fofa'', la cerda de Cartman, para un experimento genético de la escuela con el cual intentan ganarle a Terrance. Mientras, Stan lucha contra los abusos físicos de su hermana, Shelly.
programme.sub-title: Un elefante hace el amor con una cerda

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman consigue ganar dinero subiendo videos de unos bebés peleando por una pelotita de crack. Kyle piensa que eso es malo hasta que Cartman lo convence de que no es así.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman le insiste a sus amigos que los ataques terroristas del 11 de Septiembre fueron una conspiración y se dispone a desenmascarar la verdad. Por su parte, el Sr. Mackey quiere saber quién defecó en el baño.

programme.desc: Un científico y un piloto se ofrecen voluntarios para una misión de alto nivel destinada a llegar al fin del universo. Después de 13 años, la nave se estrella en el fin del universo y se adentra en lo desconocido.

programme.title: Algo Prestado
programme.desc: Las amistades se ponen a prueba y los secretos salen a la luz cuando Rachel, soltera recalcitrante, se enamora de Dex, el prometido de su mejor amiga Darcy.

programme.title: Un hombre solitario
programme.desc: Un ejecutivo intenta superar los tiempos difíciles y volver a centrarse en su carrera, después de años de excesos en los que el dinero y el sexo han marcado el inicio de una imparable decadencia personal y profesional.

programme.title: La maldición de la tumba de Tutankamon
programme.desc: En 1922, en El Cairo, un arqueólogo de teorías poco respetadas por la comunidad arqueológica, Danny Freemont, está buscando la tabla esmeralda -cuyo poseedor según la leyenda dominará el mundo- en la tumba de Tutankamon.

programme.title: Dinosaurios

programme.title: Junior Mance, Geoff Keezer, Bill Charlap & Alex Wilson
programme.desc: When renowned jazz pianists of the old and new school meet at a "Solo Piano Summit," audiences are treated to many an interesting musical surprise. The "Solo Piano Summit" brings together a handful of top pianists with different musical backgrounds: Jacky Terrasson, Junior Mance, Geoff Keezer, Bill Charlap and Alex Wilson. Besides solo performances the all-stars used the occasion for spontaneous interplay, improvisation and a fantastic finale - in short for the pleasure of virtuoso jazz piano playing.

programme.title: Charles Lloyd
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Errol Garner
programme.sub-title: Erroll Garner - Live in Singer Concertzaal, Laren
programme.desc: On June 18, 1962, American pianist and composer Erroll Garner performed at the Singer Concertzaal in Laren. The vibrant and joyous concert was played with drummer Kelly Martin and bassist Eddie Calhoun, each long-standing collaborators from Garner's trio. The Singer Concertzaal in Laren, the Netherlands is a concert hall and museum dedicated to the preservation of the art collection of American William Henry Singer. It features a variety of artists, both visual and aural.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: The Kenny Garrett Quintet
programme.desc: Appearing in the early 1980s at a time when some of jazz was refocusing on some of its historic values, Kenny Garrett was the first to show, through the dramatic intensity of his playing, that the alto could once again compete with the tenor saxophone, the instrument par excellence of the quest for jazz since John Coltrane, a musician whose influence he loudly and clearly claims. "Sounds from the Ancestors" his latest album, reflects the rich history of jazz, R&B and gospel music from the saxophonist's hometown of Detroit. But more importantly, it also has a modern cosmopolitan vibe, including music from France, Cuba, Nigeria and Guadeloupe.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Lianne La Havas
programme.desc: Lianne La Havas' performance at Casino de Paris captures the British singer-songwriter at her best: with her crystalline voice she performs soulful melodies full of sincerity. The performance is part of La Havas' 'Blood Tour', a concert tour promoting her second album 'Blood' (2015). She is accompanied by James Wyatt on keys, Adam Prendergast on bass, Giles King Ashong on drums, and Frida Touray on backing vocals.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1994, legendary swing band leader and vibraphonist Lionel Hampton performed his own arrangements of jazz standards with Junior Mance on piano, Jimmy Woode on bass and Bobby Durham on drums. They were joined by the St. Petersburg State Orchestra conducted by Alexander Tschernuschenko, to create an exciting big band sound on rousing performances of ‘In the Mood' and ‘Air Mail Special'. The program ends with Hampton singing Louis Armstrong's latter-day hit ‘What a Wonderful World'.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Dave Brubeck Trio, Cannonball Adderley Quintet, Charles Mingus Sextet & Jimmy Smith
programme.sub-title: Smith, Adderley, Brubeck, Mingus - Newport Jazz F.
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. In October 1972, an outstanding lineup played shoulder-to-shoulder at the 7th Newport Jazz Festival held in Rotterdam's then-recently built concert venue De Doelen. These four masterful groups consisted of alto saxophonist "Cannonball" Adderley and his quintet (Nat Adderley on cornet, George Duke on keyboards, Walter Booker on bass, and Roy McCurdy on drums), Hammond organist Jimmy Smith and his band (Art Farmer on flugelhorn, Illinois Jacquet on tenor saxophone, Kenny Burrell on guitar, Clark Terry on trumpet, and Roy Haynes on drums), pianist Dave Brubeck and his trio (Jack Six on bass, Alan Dawson on drums) with accompaniment from Paul Desmond on alto saxophone and Gerry Mulligan on baritone saxophone, and bassist Charles Mingus and his group (Joe Gardner on trumpet, Hamiet Bluiett on baritone saxophone, John Foster on piano, Roy Brooks on drums) with the great high-note trumpeter Cat Anderson as a guest.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer & Budapest Festival Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in an exciting concert program consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók, and Johannes Brahms. The program opens with Bach's Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This is followed by one of Bartók's best-known pieces: Music for strings, percussion and celesta. Remarkable is the work's instrumentation: Bartók divided the strings into two groups that are placed on opposite sides of the stage, to create antiphonal effects. The program ends with Brahms's Symphony No. 3 in F major, Op. 90. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on December 4, 2017.

programme.title: Jos van Immerseel, Anima Eterna Brugge, Claron McFadden & Bart Van Caenegem
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. The program opens with Gershwin's symphonic suite Catfish Row (arr. Steven D. Bowen) which is based upon music from his famous opera Porgy and Bess (1935). This is followed by the well-known tone poem An American in Paris (1928). After, soprano Claron McFadden joins the orchestra, presenting a selection of Gershwin's classic jazz songs, including ‘The man I love' (1924-27), ‘I got rhythm' (1930), and ‘By Strauss' (1936). She also performs ‘My man's gone now' and ‘Summertime' from Porgy and Bess. The concert ends with Gershwin's celebrated Rhapsody in Blue, with Bart Van Caenegem as featured pianist. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on March 3, 2017.

programme.title: Stephanie Childress, Alina Ibragimova & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Stephanie Childress conducts the London Symphony Orchestra and Sibelius and Mendelssohn provide the soundtrack for this unique concert with a distinctly Northern European flavor, live from London's LSO St Luke's. The evening begins with Jean Sibelius's En Saga, a symphonic poem that, like its composer, has become a defining figure of Finnish national musical identity. On the other side of the Baltic, it took Mendelssohn six years to complete his famed Violin Concerto—and it was well worth the wait, as violin virtuoso Alina Ibragimova's powerhouse rendition will demonstrate! The concert ends in style with two short works from Finland: Lumière et pesanteur by the fabulous Kaija Saariaho—ranked the world's greatest living composer by BBC Music Magazine—and another work by the endlessly inventive Sibelius, the spirited and episodic Cassazione.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads his Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg's Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31, recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland, USA. In addition, Welser-Möst takes a walk through ‘his' Vienna, enlightening us on this musical capital that was home to both Mozart and Schoenberg. He contrasts the Divertimento No. 2, written by 16-year-old Mozart, with Variations for Orchestra, by the mature Schoenberg.

programme.desc: This amazing concert brings together some of the true pioneers of rock n roll music including B.B. King, Bo Diddley, Jerry Lee Lewis, Little Richard, James Brown, Fats Domino and. Recorded in Italy in 1989 it features these legendary artists in performance of their best loved tracks such as Papas Got A Brand New Bag, Bo Diddley, Great Balls Of Fire, Whole Lotta Shakin Goin On and Blueberry Hill.At the end of the concert all the performers come together for all-star jam that leaves the audience hollering for more.

programme.title: Lady Gaga
programme.desc: Lady Gaga's performance at the iTunes Festival in London on September 1, 2013 marks the superstar's first full concert since the The Born This Way Ball. It is an eight song set containing the world premiere of seven tracks from her fourth album, ARTPOP: "Aura" "MANiCURE" "Artpop" "Jewels N' Drugs" ft. T.I., Too $hort and Twista "Sexxx Dreams", "Swine" and "I Wanna Be With You", a song that transformed into "Dope" for ARTPOP. During the concert, captured stunningly in HD, Gaga says that she's "a bit like Dorothy right now." The stage is her Kansas, the crowd is her family, and their reunion is pure magic. Lady Gaga, her dancers, and her band traverse through visual and musical themes of love, sex, violence, beauty, danger, empowerment, hustle, lust, and above all ART. Throughout, Gaga lays her heart bare for the audience and the cameras with every note sung and every word spoken.

Kidnapped along with her daughter Christy, it's a tense game of hunt - or be hunted - against a ruthless gang of degenerates and their violently unhinged matriarch, Becky. programme.title: Junior Mance, Geoff Keezer, Bill Charlap & Alex Wilson
programme.desc: When renowned jazz pianists of the old and new school meet at a "Solo Piano Summit," audiences are treated to many an interesting musical surprise. The "Solo Piano Summit" brings together a handful of top pianists with different musical backgrounds: Jacky Terrasson, Junior Mance, Geoff Keezer, Bill Charlap and Alex Wilson. Besides solo performances the all-stars used the occasion for spontaneous interplay, improvisation and a fantastic finale - in short for the pleasure of virtuoso jazz piano playing.

programme.title: Charles Lloyd
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Errol Garner
programme.sub-title: Erroll Garner - Live in Singer Concertzaal, Laren
programme.desc: On June 18, 1962, American pianist and composer Erroll Garner performed at the Singer Concertzaal in Laren. The vibrant and joyous concert was played with drummer Kelly Martin and bassist Eddie Calhoun, each long-standing collaborators from Garner's trio. The Singer Concertzaal in Laren, the Netherlands is a concert hall and museum dedicated to the preservation of the art collection of American William Henry Singer. It features a variety of artists, both visual and aural.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: The Kenny Garrett Quintet
programme.desc: Appearing in the early 1980s at a time when some of jazz was refocusing on some of its historic values, Kenny Garrett was the first to show, through the dramatic intensity of his playing, that the alto could once again compete with the tenor saxophone, the instrument par excellence of the quest for jazz since John Coltrane, a musician whose influence he loudly and clearly claims. "Sounds from the Ancestors" his latest album, reflects the rich history of jazz, R&B and gospel music from the saxophonist's hometown of Detroit. But more importantly, it also has a modern cosmopolitan vibe, including music from France, Cuba, Nigeria and Guadeloupe.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Lianne La Havas
programme.desc: Lianne La Havas' performance at Casino de Paris captures the British singer-songwriter at her best: with her crystalline voice she performs soulful melodies full of sincerity. The performance is part of La Havas' 'Blood Tour', a concert tour promoting her second album 'Blood' (2015). She is accompanied by James Wyatt on keys, Adam Prendergast on bass, Giles King Ashong on drums, and Frida Touray on backing vocals.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1994, legendary swing band leader and vibraphonist Lionel Hampton performed his own arrangements of jazz standards with Junior Mance on piano, Jimmy Woode on bass and Bobby Durham on drums. They were joined by the St. Petersburg State Orchestra conducted by Alexander Tschernuschenko, to create an exciting big band sound on rousing performances of ‘In the Mood' and ‘Air Mail Special'. The program ends with Hampton singing Louis Armstrong's latter-day hit ‘What a Wonderful World'.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Dave Brubeck Trio, Cannonball Adderley Quintet, Charles Mingus Sextet & Jimmy Smith
programme.sub-title: Smith, Adderley, Brubeck, Mingus - Newport Jazz F.
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. In October 1972, an outstanding lineup played shoulder-to-shoulder at the 7th Newport Jazz Festival held in Rotterdam's then-recently built concert venue De Doelen. These four masterful groups consisted of alto saxophonist "Cannonball" Adderley and his quintet (Nat Adderley on cornet, George Duke on keyboards, Walter Booker on bass, and Roy McCurdy on drums), Hammond organist Jimmy Smith and his band (Art Farmer on flugelhorn, Illinois Jacquet on tenor saxophone, Kenny Burrell on guitar, Clark Terry on trumpet, and Roy Haynes on drums), pianist Dave Brubeck and his trio (Jack Six on bass, Alan Dawson on drums) with accompaniment from Paul Desmond on alto saxophone and Gerry Mulligan on baritone saxophone, and bassist Charles Mingus and his group (Joe Gardner on trumpet, Hamiet Bluiett on baritone saxophone, John Foster on piano, Roy Brooks on drums) with the great high-note trumpeter Cat Anderson as a guest.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto & Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Mahler's Third Symphony, composed between 1895 and 1896, is an expansive, programmatic work that explores themes of nature, humanity, and spiritual ascent. It features a massive orchestra, a female choir, a children's choir, and a mezzo-soprano soloist, creating a vast soundscape depicting everything from nature's beauty to deeper philosophical questions about existence. The symphony is structured in six movements, moving from the "awakening of nature" to a spiritual conclusion, inspired by Nietzsche and folk poetry.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer & Budapest Festival Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in an exciting concert program consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók, and Johannes Brahms. The program opens with Bach's Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This is followed by one of Bartók's best-known pieces: Music for strings, percussion and celesta. Remarkable is the work's instrumentation: Bartók divided the strings into two groups that are placed on opposite sides of the stage, to create antiphonal effects. The program ends with Brahms's Symphony No. 3 in F major, Op. 90. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on December 4, 2017.

programme.title: Jos van Immerseel, Anima Eterna Brugge, Claron McFadden & Bart Van Caenegem
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. The program opens with Gershwin's symphonic suite Catfish Row (arr. Steven D. Bowen) which is based upon music from his famous opera Porgy and Bess (1935). This is followed by the well-known tone poem An American in Paris (1928). After, soprano Claron McFadden joins the orchestra, presenting a selection of Gershwin's classic jazz songs, including ‘The man I love' (1924-27), ‘I got rhythm' (1930), and ‘By Strauss' (1936). She also performs ‘My man's gone now' and ‘Summertime' from Porgy and Bess. The concert ends with Gershwin's celebrated Rhapsody in Blue, with Bart Van Caenegem as featured pianist. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on March 3, 2017.

programme.title: Stephanie Childress, Alina Ibragimova & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Stephanie Childress conducts the London Symphony Orchestra and Sibelius and Mendelssohn provide the soundtrack for this unique concert with a distinctly Northern European flavor, live from London's LSO St Luke's. The evening begins with Jean Sibelius's En Saga, a symphonic poem that, like its composer, has become a defining figure of Finnish national musical identity. On the other side of the Baltic, it took Mendelssohn six years to complete his famed Violin Concerto—and it was well worth the wait, as violin virtuoso Alina Ibragimova's powerhouse rendition will demonstrate! The concert ends in style with two short works from Finland: Lumière et pesanteur by the fabulous Kaija Saariaho—ranked the world's greatest living composer by BBC Music Magazine—and another work by the endlessly inventive Sibelius, the spirited and episodic Cassazione.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads his Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg's Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31, recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland, USA. In addition, Welser-Möst takes a walk through ‘his' Vienna, enlightening us on this musical capital that was home to both Mozart and Schoenberg. He contrasts the Divertimento No. 2, written by 16-year-old Mozart, with Variations for Orchestra, by the mature Schoenberg.

programme.title: Elton John
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Elton John featuring unforgettable version of his hits: "Tiny Dancer", "Rocket Man", "Your Song" and many more…

programme.title: Ray Charles, Bo Diddley, James Brown & B.B. King
programme.desc: This amazing concert brings together some of the true pioneers of rock n roll music including B.B. King, Bo Diddley, Jerry Lee Lewis, Little Richard, James Brown, Fats Domino and. Recorded in Italy in 1989 it features these legendary artists in performance of their best loved tracks such as Papas Got A Brand New Bag, Bo Diddley, Great Balls Of Fire, Whole Lotta Shakin Goin On and Blueberry Hill.At the end of the concert all the performers come together for all-star jam that leaves the audience hollering for more.

programme.title: Paul McCartney
programme.desc: Paul McCartney presents this special performance of the US Tour, made in the United States, 11 weeks and 34 shows, playing great compositions of his solo career along with some Wings and Beatles songs.

programme.title: Lady Gaga
programme.desc: Lady Gaga's performance at the iTunes Festival in London on September 1, 2013 marks the superstar's first full concert since the The Born This Way Ball. It is an eight song set containing the world premiere of seven tracks from her fourth album, ARTPOP: "Aura" "MANiCURE" "Artpop" "Jewels N' Drugs" ft. T.I., Too $hort and Twista "Sexxx Dreams", "Swine" and "I Wanna Be With You", a song that transformed into "Dope" for ARTPOP. During the concert, captured stunningly in HD, Gaga says that she's "a bit like Dorothy right now." The stage is her Kansas, the crowd is her family, and their reunion is pure magic. Lady Gaga, her dancers, and her band traverse through visual and musical themes of love, sex, violence, beauty, danger, empowerment, hustle, lust, and above all ART. Throughout, Gaga lays her heart bare for the audience and the cameras with every note sung and every word spoken.

Convencido de que Novak es un fraude, el reportero estrella de una revista masculina intenta desenmascararla, haciendo que se enamore de él...

programme.title: Bichos raros
programme.desc: Una comedia irónica que narra el romance estrafalario de dos inadaptados. Lily es tímida, poquita cosa, dulce y rara. Este último es el calificativo que más abunda sobre ella, la causa de que a sus espaldas todos la señalen a carcajadas. Aún así, para Lily eso no es motivo de amargura, al contrario: es feliz sabiéndose distinta. Trabaja como cajera en un restaurante de comida rápida, y ya ni escucha las burlas de sus propios compañeros. Está demasiado pendiente de una hora concreta al mediodía, porque ése es el momento en que aparece para comer Jarrod, alguien como ella, otro inadaptado. Jarrod trabaja en una tienda de videojuegos, se considera un genio y sale de una depresión para meterse en otra. Jarrod prepara una fiesta de disfraces donde cada invitado se vestirá como su animal favorito. El suyo es un águila, el de Lily un tiburón.

Inmersa y abrumada, Isabelle se encuentra inesperadamente con la madre biológica de su hija y juntas buscan la forma de seguir adelante.
